subject: FintechCo — API auth & key management (post-call recap & next steps)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: FintechCo — API auth & key management (post-call recap & next steps)

Thanks for the call today, Alex — good discussion. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

Summary:
- Use case: server-to-server inference for transaction enrichment + embeddings-based similarity for fraud signals.
- Traffic profile: ~300 req/s peak, median prompt length ~350 tokens, strict P95 latency target 300ms.

Auth & key management topics we committed to follow up on:
1) Recommended auth patterns: API keys for server-to-server + optional short-lived OAuth/JWT for rotating credentials and scoped service accounts.
2) Key rotation: support for rolling API key rotation with zero-downtime (dual-key warm swap) + background re-sign for cached clients.
3) Service accounts: ability to create scoped service accounts tied to FintechCo org + per-env restrictions (prod vs staging).
4) SDK integration: sample code for SDK-based token refresh, automatic retry on 401, and routing by region/capacity.
5) Embeddings/rerankers: secure model access controls and scoped keys for embedding endpoints; discuss separate keys/roles for high-cost reranker calls.

Attachments sent (see Drive link below): integration-checklist.xlsx (integration checklist), redwood-auth-patterns.pdf (auth patterns + examples). Also attached the security questionnaire you mentioned: fintechco-security-questions.pdf.

Proposed next steps:
- I will send the SDK snippets and rotation pattern doc by EOD tomorrow (10/2).
- Alex: confirm whether FintechCo wants service accounts per microservice or a single shared service account for the ingestion cluster.
- Priya (security): please flag any additional controls you need (HSM/KMS integrations, audit log format).

If that looks right I'll schedule a short technical sync next week to walk the SDK samples and rotation flow.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0198

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@fintechco.com>, FintechCo Security <security@fintechco.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T16:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FintechCo — API auth & key management (post-call recap & next steps)

Thanks Marissa, this is helpful. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

- Service accounts: we'd prefer one service account per microservice (ingest, enrichment, reranker) so we can enforce least privilege and rotate independently.
- Rotation window: security requires ability to rotate keys without >5 minute disruption; please outline the dual-key warm swap pattern and expected client behavior.
- KMS/HSM: we use AWS KMS & CloudHSM for our secrets; can Redwood integrate for key wrapping or do we need to manage keys on our side?

Also, can you include a short sample showing:
- SDK example (Node + Python) performing a refresh of a short-lived JWT using a service account private key, then calling the embeddings endpoint with scoped permissions
- How to set up routing rules so high-cost reranker calls always go to dedicated capacity to control spend

Priya, can you confirm whether the attached security questionnaire covers everything you need? If not I can add follow-up items.

Appreciate the quick turn here — we want to schedule the technical sync on 10/6 or 10/7 (PST). 10/6 afternoon PST works for me.

—Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Integrations
FintechCo
alex.johnson@fintechco.com

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@fintechco.com>
Date: 2026-10-02T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FintechCo — API auth & key management (post-call recap & next steps)

Alex — thanks for the notes, and great call yesterday. Short answers and what we'll deliver before the sync: 

Quick answers:
- Service accounts: recommend per-microservice accounts (agree with your approach). We'll include RBAC examples for embeddings vs reranker scopes.
- Rotation: our recommended pattern is dual active keys with an overlap window. Client behavior: try new key, fallback to previous for N retries, then flag and rotate. We'll provide code that performs a warm swap with no downtime for typical SDKs.
- KMS/HSM: Redwood can integrate with customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS, GCP KMS) for envelope encryption of long-term secrets. For HSM-backed signing of JWTs we support integrations via our Private deployment; we'll document the options.

Deliverables (we will upload to the Drive link):
- redwood-auth-patterns.pdf: high-level patterns + code snippets (Node, Python).
- SDK samples: node-auth-refresh.js, python_auth_refresh.py (examples for service account JWT flow + token refresh).
- integration-checklist.xlsx: mapping of endpoints, required perms, client behaviors, and test vectors.
- fintechco-security-questions.pdf: answered version of your questionnaire + notes on audit-log schema.

Action items before the sync (10/6 afternoon PST suggested):
1) Marissa: confirm meeting time and send calendar invite (10/6 2:00pm PST tentatively).
2) Alex: confirm per-microservice service accounts (ingest, enrichment, reranker) — you said yes but please confirm in reply.
3) Priya: flag any additional security controls (we'll treat HSM signing and KMS integration as higher-touch items).

If Alex confirms 10/6 2pm PST we'll include an additional hour for hands-on SDK walkthrough and a short demo of rotation.

Thanks — uploading deliverables now and will share the Drive link shortly.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com
